The '''RX7 ion engine''' was a model of military-grade [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]] manufactured by [[Damorian Manufacturing Corporation/Legends|Damorian Manufacturing Corporation]]. [[Salla Zend]]'s ''[[Starlight Intruder]]'' was powered by four RX7 ion engines.<ref name="EGVV" />
